parameters.apprise_url_plus: parseps://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.app_id_secret }} }:${ customer_secrets.{{ params.master_key_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.host_secret }} }
parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Parse Platform destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-parseplatform` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `parseps://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available. The free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. The `gateway` and `gateway-plus` channels skip Apprise and transform the envelope into a native Parse Platform push payload delivered straight to your Parse Server: `gateway` is free (direct to your Parse Platform push API), and `gateway-plus` is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment Parse Platform destinations.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"where":{},"data":{"alert":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Parse Platform destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Parse Platform push API (no Apprise)

app_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Parse Platform app id

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Parse Platform host

master_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Parse Platform master key
